name: HIPAA Security Rule: risk analysis, access, audit, integrity and transmission security
description: HIPAA Security Rule: risk analysis, access, audit, integrity and transmission security. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: A current security risk analysis covers the agent
controls.requirement: A current security risk analysis covers the agent, its model destinations, tools and stores.

controls.title: A risk management plan records the measures taken against each risk found
controls.requirement: A risk management plan records the measures taken against each risk found.

controls.title: Audit records are reviewed on a schedule by a named role
controls.requirement: Audit records are reviewed on a schedule by a named role.

controls.title: Security official
controls.requirement: Security official, workforce security, access management and awareness training attestations are current.

controls.title: Security incident procedures exist and agent incidents are recorded as events
controls.requirement: Security incident procedures exist and agent incidents are recorded as events.

controls.title: The contingency plan covers the agent
controls.requirement: The contingency plan covers the agent: backups, disaster recovery and emergency mode.

controls.title: Periodic evaluation
controls.requirement: Periodic evaluation, repeated after a change (a model version change counts).

controls.title: Every caller has a unique identity
controls.requirement: Every caller has a unique identity; no shared service account reaches PHI.

controls.title: Emergency access is documented
controls.requirement: Emergency access is documented, limited to named roles, logged and reviewed.

controls.title: PHI at rest in vaults
controls.requirement: PHI at rest in vaults, traces, caches and eval sets is encrypted.

controls.title: Every PHI access and model call produces a signed
controls.requirement: Every PHI access and model call produces a signed, hash-chained record.

controls.title: Stored PHI and records are protected from alteration
controls.requirement: Stored PHI and records are protected from alteration; chain verification passes.

controls.title: Callers and tools are authenticated
controls.requirement: Callers and tools are authenticated; model destinations are pinned to a version.

controls.title: Model and tool endpoints use TLS
controls.requirement: Model and tool endpoints use TLS; plain HTTP is refused.

controls.title: Physical safeguards are attested for every site hosting the runtime
controls.requirement: Physical safeguards are attested for every site hosting the runtime.

controls.title: Security policies and documentation are retained six years
controls.requirement: Security policies and documentation are retained six years.
